lessons_learned: AST_MTR_002 healthy baseline: 1.8 to 2.0 mm/s vib, 51 to 54C temp. Any reading above 2.5 mm/s or above 60C warrants increased monitoring. Healthy preventive checks provide the most reliable baseline calibration data for the Monitoring Agent. Post-lubrication baseline: 1.7 mm/s vib, 51C temp.
